text:
maria-partnerships: Quick heads-up: Felipe flagged a gating issue for the LATAM edge region we want to light up next Friday. Marketplace listing + quota entitlements are still pending.

felipe-gcp-partner: Correct — southamerica-west1 shows 'Pending entitlement' in the partner portal. I opened ticket GCP-6421 for the marketplace side and a quota request on our end.

cj-ops: Can you paste exact quota SKUs and counts we requested? Need to put them in the escalation email.

felipe-gcp-partner: Request submitted for 40 x a2-highgpu-1g (A100-equivalent) split across two zones, plus 200 vCPU reserved for burst workloads. Portal has SKU IDs and the ticket thread.

arjun-cloud-partner: If entitlements don't clear in time, we need a fallback routing plan. Can we route LATAM traffic to us-west1 (hosted) and maintain customer SLOs?

maria-partnerships: Fallback is possible but with higher p95 latency (~80ms to Santiago) vs target ~40ms. Product insists on at least a small canary in LATAM for validation.

ana-partner-ops: small correction: that's @ana-partner-ops. Also confirming: legal signoff is required before marketplace listing goes live.

lucy-legal: I need the marketplace T&Cs + the partner MSA to review residency/PII clauses. Felipe, can you attach the docs or links?

felipe-gcp-partner: Links: https://partner-gcp.example.com/entitlements/GCP-6421 and marketplace draft: https://gcp.marketplace/example/listing-draft (access granted to the team). No additional residency clauses in the draft — standard DPA language only.

cj-ops: Ops checklist for provisioning:
- submit quota request (GCP-6421)
- partner entitlement approved in marketplace portal
- billing account linked + committed SKU
- infra verifies node image (runtime-llm-v3) compatibility

arjun-cloud-partner: I'll own infra compatibility and run a parity test with runtime-llm-v3. @deploy-bot can you schedule a smoke deploy once quotas are confirmed?

deploy-bot: scheduled smoke deploy -> staging-southamerica-west1 at 2026-03-26T02:00Z (pending quotas/entitlement).

maria-partnerships: Proposed timeline: today — legal review + quota escalation; +48h partner entitlements; +72h infra smoke; canary next Friday. Feels tight but doable if approvals move fast.

felipe-gcp-partner: We can escalate to partner engineering now; marketplace ops response usually 48–96h after legal signoff. We'll ping them.

lucy-legal: I'll review the marketplace draft by EOD and flag any PII/residency concerns. If none, I'll provide explicit approval note for the partner portal.

ana-partner-ops: I'll create an internal tracking ticket TG-1258 to list owners and approvals. Adding CJ for infra, Lucy for legal, Felipe for partner follow-ups.

cj-ops: Submitting quota escalation now with 'urgent: go-live' in the priority field. Pasting request payload below for records:
```
{
  "project": "redwood-latam-edge",
  "region": "southamerica-west1",
  "skus": ["a2-highgpu-1g"],
  "count": 40,
  "vcpus": 200,
  "priority": "urgent-go-live"
}
```

felipe-gcp-partner: Confirmed. I'll follow up with partner eng and loop in marketplace ops (cc: marketplace-ops@gcp.example).

maria-partnerships: Please react with :white_check_mark: when your action item is done. I'll maintain TG-1258 and will escalate if we slip on the timeline. Thanks everyone.

cj-ops: (after) Quota escalation submitted and screenshot of confirmation sent to TG-1258. :white_check_mark:

lucy-legal: Reviewed and approved the marketplace draft — no extra residency clauses. Posted approval note in the partner portal. :white_check_mark:

felipe-gcp-partner: Partner engineering acknowledged GCP-6421 and elevated to priority review. Following up every 4 hours until closure.

arjun-cloud-partner: Ran image compatibility checks on runtime-llm-v3 in staging and saw one kernel mismatch on a2 images — working with infra to patch the node image.

ana-partner-ops: TG-1258 updated with current statuses and ETA for entitlement approval set to 2026-03-25T18:00Z.

maria-partnerships: Great progress. If entitlement lands by 18:00 UTC tomorrow we keep the Friday canary. If not, we delay canary by 72h and notify product/customer pilots.

deploy-bot: smoke deploy remains pending until quota + entitlement cleared. Will auto-trigger when both are present.
